senses.gloss: (b. h. נשׂק)to go up, ascend; v. מָסַק.
to impose a tax, to assess, v. מַסִּיק II.
to bring to a conclusion, v. מַסִּיק I. I.
to put on wood, to make the flame rise; [cmp. עָלָה Hif.,] to start a fire, to heat.
units: <cite ref="Beitzah 32a">Bets. 32ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <he>מַסִּיקִין בכלים וכ׳</he> you may, on the Holy Day, use wooden vessels for heating &c.
<cite ref="Pesachim 27b:6">Pes. 27ᵇ</cite> <he>המַסִּיק</he> he who put the wood on.
<cite ref="Pesachim 27b:2">Ib.</cite> <he>תנור שהִסִּיקוֹ וכ׳</he> if one heated an oven with wood belonging to the sanctuary &c.
<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 3:1">Sabb. III, 1</cite> <he>כירה שהִסִּיקוּהָ בקש וכ׳</he> a range which they heated with straw &c.
<cite ref="Tosefta Yoma 2:5">Tosef. Yoma II, 5</cite>; <cite ref="Yoma 38a:7">Yoma 38ᵃ</cite> <he>מַסִּיקִין מבפנים</he> placed the fire deep into the stove.
<cite ref="Shabbat 41a">Sabb. 41ᵃ</cite>; a. fr.—[<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 28:2">Midr. Till. to Ps. XXVIII</cite>, v. infra.]

senses.gloss: ; Hof. הוּסָּק to be heated. Y. Ber. IV, 8ᵇ top נִסּוֹקֶת; ib. IX, 14ᵇ top נִיסּ׳, v. מֶרְחָץ.—
units: <cite ref="Pesachim 30b">Pes. 30ᵇ</cite> top <he>הא ה׳ התנור</he> but if the oven has been made glowing.

<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 28:2">Midr. Till. to Ps. XXVIII</cite> <he>אם הוא נ׳ … יהא ני׳ וכ׳</he> if it (the furnace) is usually heated with one bundle, let it now be heated with seven; <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 28:2">ib.</cite> <he>אם הוא מסיק בשבעה יהא מסיק וכ׳</he> (corr. acc.) if it is heated with seven bundles, let it be heated &c.
<cite ref="Tosefta Chullin 1:22">Tosef. Ḥull. I, 22</cite> <he>עד שלא הוּסְּקוּ</he> before they are hardened by heating; a. fr.
